name: Satake Akitoshi
source:
[b]“I definitely recommend Kaito to be your bodyguard, my Lady. As you can see he’s quite the resilient individual.”[/b]

Satake used to be a bodyguard of the Nikaidou family (Genzou’s to be exact). Now he spends his days as the headmaster of Ren’Ou Academy. 

He’s completely bald, his skin somewhat tanned, and has a personality and looks that could scare more than one passerby. Don’t let his looks deceive you, though, as Satake has a natural predisposition to judge other people’s character like no other, and has an extraordinary skill to empathise with others. 

He’s always wearing sunglasses, so it’s almost impossible to know what he feels or what he’s thinking about by reading his eyes. 

Satake is the only person who knows everything about Kaito’s past.

Hobbies: Though Satake may have hobbies, these are completely unknown to us.

Likes: Satake has always a soft spot for children, as well as having his occasional smoke or glass of whisky whenever he has some time for himself.

Dislikes: What Satake hates more than anything is people lacking the willpower and guts to carry things through to the end.

[From [url=https://daybreaktl.wordpress.com/projectoverview/meet-the-characters]Daybreak Translations[/url]]
